Huma Qureshi Defends Kiara Advani Over Intimate Scene Criticism

Actress Huma Qureshi has defended Kiara Advani against criticism regarding intimate scenes in the film 'Toxic'. Qureshi stated that the film will prove its critics wrong. She also called the online trolling 'disgusting'. The controversy arose from intimate scenes in the song 'Tabahi' from the film.
